whoItsFor: Developers, analysts, and researchers who want a self-hostable, real-time situational awareness dashboard that aggregates news and geopolitical, financial, and infrastructure signals. The README also targets agents and scripts through its MCP server, REST API, CLI, and SDKs.
useCases: Monitor global geopolitical events and cross-stream escalation signals on a 3D globe or flat map
Track country instability scores, finance markets, and commodities in one dashboard
Pull live intelligence programmatically via the MCP server, REST API, CLI, or SDKs
